This tests for a bug where pasted content starting with an interchange newline would end up
outside of the editable region where it was pasted. You should see 'foo\nbar' below.
| "
"
| <div>
|   contenteditable="true"
|   id="test"
|   "foo"
|   <div>
|     "bar<#selection-caret>"
|     <br>
| "
non-editable
"
| <script>
|   "
runTest();
